metadata.title: Complete non-orientable minimal surfaces of finite total curvature: Approximation and interpolation
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove a uniform approximation theorem with interpolation for complete non-orientable minimal surfaces of finite total curvature in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ $(n\ge 3)$. In particular, we establish the existence of such surfaces with the complex structure of any open conformal non-orientable surface of finite topology and parabolic type.
